questions.q: Under the Queen's case, a neighbor is any feature that…
options: touches the feature, even at a single corner
questions.why: Rook's case requires a shared edge. Queen's case counts any touch.

questions.q: Median household income by NC census tract has a Moran's I of 0.59. This suggests…
questions.why: Moran's I runs from -1 to 1. Positive values mean similar values sit near each other.

questions.q: What does LISA tell you that a global Moran's I does not?
options: Whether the data are normally distributed
Where significant clusters and outliers are
The regression coefficient for each tract
questions.why: LISA calculates a statistic for every location, so you can map where the clustering is.

questions.q: You think high house prices spill over into neighboring tracts. Which model fits that hypothesis?
questions.why: The lag model lets outcomes in one place depend on outcomes next door. The error model is for spatially structured variables you didn't measure.
